questions.q: What device-management platform does the BV420D support, and how does it differ from Zebra?
o: Zebra Print DNA, same as Zebra
SOTI Connect, which is vendor-neutral across mixed estates
questions.e: The BV420D is SOTI Connect certified — a vendor-neutral console — versus Zebra's Zebra-only Print DNA.

questions.q: Which Toshiba BV420D variant offers a linerless option the Zebra ZD421 lacks?
questions.e: The BV420D-GL02 includes an integrated linerless cutter — useful in food, retail and QSR. The ZD421 has no linerless option.

questions.q: Which Zebra label printer does the Toshiba BV420D replace in the 'Kill the Zebra' strategy?
questions.e: The BV420D is positioned directly against the Zebra ZD421(d), the 4-inch desktop direct-thermal printer.
